CustomField.description: True if this is the first occurrence of this error. When the millisecond field First_Occurred_Timestamp__c is populated, compares it to Created_Timestamp__c so repeats within the same second are not falsely flagged as new. For historical/legacy logs where that field is blank, falls back to the original second-precision comparison of First_Occurred_On__c to Created_At__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: True if this is the first occurrence of this error
CustomField.label: Is New
